question: In 1838, who published an article discussing the structure and origin of plant cells?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Matthias Schleiden__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Matthias Schleiden** was a German botanist and** co-founder of cell theory.**
 
• In **1838 Schleiden **defined the cell as the basic unit of plant structure.
 
• Initially discovered by **Robert Hooke **in 1665.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Robert Brown **published his research findings and gave speeches.**
 
• **Virchow's** many discoveries include **finding cells in bone and connective tissue** and **describing substances such as myelin**.
 
• **Kolliker's** investigations covered such diverse subjects as the development of cephalopods.
